title: Swap-free CFD book: the crypto CFD book for firms / account types that charge no overnight swap on crypto

portfolio: Gen72 P1 point-in-time equal risk, Weiss at half weight, 30-day vol targeting; reported at swap 0 and at 2x spread
prop: FTMO 2-Step, FundedNext Stellar 2-Step, BrightFunded 2-Step Classic: Gen79-adopted setting 1.5 / 1.0 / 60% stop and the default 1.0 / 0.6 / 50%, bootstrap 500 paths
comparison: vs the base CFD book (C* + Weiss, swap 3.3 bp/day)
